profile.headline: Software Engineer | 8+ yrs Real Estate Tech | Full-stack delivery from concept to production | Python • TypeScript • SQL • AWS & GCP • Docker/Kubernetes • GitLab/GitHub CI/CD | AI-enabled applications

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led a 5-person team building a loan origination and underwriting platform projected to process $3B+ in annual transactions.

Designed full-stack architecture integrating 4+ internal apps via microservices and micro-frontends, enabling reuse of 100k+ lines of legacy code without duplication or costly upgrades.

Partnered with product to deliver a year-long value stream roadmap, aligning technical execution with business goals.

Introduced AI into development workflows (code generation, automated testing) and customer-facing features, shortening delivery cycles by 20% and differentiating the product.

Collaborated with senior leadership on enterprise-wide architecture encompassing 100+ services, pipelines, and exports, and spearheaded implementation of a comprehensive end-to-end testing framework.
positions.insights: Agile Methodologies, Engineering Management and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Centralized task and file management for loan servicing and closing, consolidating previously siloed workflows and reducing turnaround times by ~30%.

Migrated platform from GCP to AWS, improving scalability and reducing infrastructure spend by ~25%.

Built a web-based Word-style editor integrated with multiple data sources, enabling customized  reporting and saving teams ~5 hours per week of manual document work.
positions.insights: Technical Leadership, Agile Methodologies and +1 skill

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Built document parsers that reduced manual work for producers and underwriters by an estimated 8 hours per deal, shortening underwriting cycles and speeding deal approvals.

Developed an API to integrate Excel-based workflows into the centralized database, eliminating duplicate data entry and ensuring consistency across teams.

Created an exit analysis tool for property deals, enabling underwriting teams to model long-term profitability and support multimillion-dollar investment decisions.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered and managed GCP pipelines processing billions of real estate records, delivering clean, reliable data for both end users and predictive models.

Integrated geospatial data from Google Maps and OpenStreetMap, enriching models with location-based insights and improving accuracy of rent and valuation predictions.

Built parcel-level geospatial matching in GCP pipelines to deduplicate property listings, significantly improving data integrity and reliability for downstream applications.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and published an iOS mobile game, approved and distributed on the Apple App Store.

Implemented monetization through in-app purchases and advertising, generating revenue from a live user base.

Handled end-to-end product lifecycle, from coding and design to deployment and updates.

projects.title: Zen.py
projects.description:
Python and Arduino code for automating a zen garden. Uses HTML/CSS and JavaScript located here https://github.com/sitver/zen-web in order to create an interactive map on a web server. That server creates a json file of the coordinates that is then convered by a python script into an array of angle coordinates that can be used by an arduino. The arduino can control a hardware arm via servos that can draw in a sand garden.

A project by Gregory Howlett-Gomez, Michael Sitver, Max Dubrinsky, Holly Buteau for Uncommon Hacks 2017. Was a finalist and won the Chendogu prive.

projects.title: Space Phish
projects.description: Space Phish is a mobile app for iOS. It stars a fish attempting to avoid asteroids. It is created used libraries written in both Objective C and Swift. The actual code itself is based upon the Xcode game template, and uses Google AdMob plus in app purchases for revenue.
